name: HSE — adult ADHD team implementation status (PQ 3414-26)
description: HSE parliamentary-response route about the establishment and operational status of planned public adult ADHD teams nationally in 2026.
intended_use: Use as point-in-time implementation evidence showing why a national Model of Care must not be read as universal current service availability.
audience_or_context: Adults and professionals in the Republic of Ireland checking current public adult ADHD rollout context.
limitations: This is a point-in-time parliamentary response, not a stable referral directory.
Team availability, recruitment, catchments and capacity can change quickly and require local/current checking.
The response should not be used to infer access in a particular county without matching regional evidence.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible HSE publication page; current access still requires checking the relevant local/regional service.
conflicts_of_interest: HSE is reporting on implementation of its own programme; ND Oracle uses the response to preserve implementation uncertainty rather than infer success.

provenance.method: HSE PQ 3414-26 publication page checked on 2026-09-04 for current national adult ADHD team implementation context. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
